title: 200 original Chemistry questions for the first-assessment-2025 syllabus
status: Original practice; not official IB questions
sourceScope: Official public 2025 Paper 1A papers and the current-syllabus specimen set. No claim to have obtained every May/November or timezone past paper. Source documents were consulted online; source links are retained, not redistributed copies.

sources.title: Chemistry guide: first assessment 2025
sources.use: Structure/Reactivity syllabus, command terms and SL/HL assessment scope

sources.title: Chemistry SL/HL specimen papers and markschemes
sources.use: Paper 1A, Paper 1B and Paper 2 formats, data interpretation and marking conventions

authorship: Written independently around the assessed skills, command terms and difficulty. Source question wording, distinctive scenarios and figures are not reproduced. These are not one-to-one numerical substitutions of official questions.
syllabusScope: All six Structure/Reactivity themes and all 22 subtopics; HL-only content is flagged ahl and excluded from SL routes.

figures.format: Original embedded safe SVG; precise scientific graphs, spectra, structures and orbital diagrams
figures.data: Constructed datasets are explicitly identified in questions

review: Author review, 65 separate numerical recomputations, production schema and mark-total checks, exact-duplicate checks against the existing 800 Chemistry questions, rendering and course-access checks. No separate human examiner moderation.

reproduce.browserReview: Set CHROME_BIN if needed, then node scripts/verify-ib-chemistry-2025-browser.mjs
reproduce.index: npm run generate:ib-content-index && npm run verify:ib-content-index && npm run verify:ib-content-loading
